import sys

def main():
    s = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    l = len(s)
    out = [s[0]]
    at_done = False
    i = 1
    while i < l:
        if i != l - 3 and s[i:i+3] == "dot":
            out.append('.')
            i += 3
        elif i != l - 2 and s[i:i+2] == "at" and not at_done:
            out.append('@')
            i += 2
            at_done = True
        else:
            out.append(s[i])
            i += 1
    sys.stdout.write(''.join(out))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
